title: stitchspawn
body:
🏠 EasySpawn — Simple & Configurable Spawn Management
Set, manage and teleport to your server spawn with ease. EasySpawn is a lightweight, no-nonsense spawn plugin for Spigot & Paper servers — fully configurable through a simple config.yml and ready to go in seconds.
✨ Features:

Easy Setup — Set your spawn point with a single command. No complicated steps, just stand where you want it and run /setspawn.
Instant Teleportation — Players can return to spawn anytime with /spawn, with a configurable warmup timer to prevent abuse.
First Join & Death Spawn — Automatically teleport new players to spawn on first join and respawn players at the set location on death.
Cooldown & Delay Support — Set a teleport warmup and cooldown per permission group to keep things balanced on your server.
Multiple Spawn Points — Define different spawns for different worlds, keeping each part of your server organized.
Permission Support — Control who can set spawn, who can teleport, and who bypasses cooldowns — fully configurable per rank.
Lightweight & Fast — No unnecessary bloat. Just a clean, reliable spawn system that works every time.

⚙️ Perfect for:
Survival servers, mini-game networks, RPG worlds, or any server that needs a simple and dependable spawn system.
